Are teaching assistants' jobs the same as lead teachers' jobs?

No. Regular school assistants support teaching under teacher guidance, and the teacher holds main responsibility for designing and implementing the education plan. Elementary or kindergarten teachers each have curriculum goals and evaluation tasks; shared student materials and classroom settings do not automatically grant qualifications or plan decision authority to one another. description.text: Teaching assistants support regular preschool, elementary, middle, or high school instruction under teacher guidance, assisting with individual or small-group review, preparing materials, maintaining records, and supervising student activities; the teacher holds main responsibility for designing and implementing the education plan. This page fixes O*NET-SOC25-9042.00 and excludes special education specialist assistants and postsecondary assistants. The US BLS25-9045 wages and employment are a combined reference covering regular, special education, and other non-postsecondary assistants and cannot be treated as a separate statistic for this occupation. In China, first check actual job duties, teaching qualification applicability, entry inquiry, and student protection; paper work grants no independent teaching, guardianship, or diagnostic authority.
